title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
description: Discover the functional study hubs and social lounges that Davidson students rely on for daily productivity and community connection beyond the standard tour stops.

cards.title: The Interim Library Hub
cards.subtitle: Chambers Building
cards.notes: Visit this historic gallery in Chambers Building, currently serving as the main collaborative study space and library service point during E.H. Little Library renovations.
cards.short_summary: The Lilly Family Gallery is the primary interim library space at Davidson College during major renovations.
cards.evidence_claim: Lilly Family Gallery is the main collaborative study space during the library renovation, housing staff, course reserves, and printers.
cards.source_title: Using The Library During Construction - Davidson College
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 for students with CatCard access; staff available during business hours.

cards.title: The Wall Center Forum
cards.subtitle: E. Craig Wall Jr. Academic Center
cards.notes: Study on the wooden amphitheater steps or at tables in this sunlit, modern atrium that connects the college's science departments.
cards.short_summary: A massive, modern atrium in the Wall Academic Center featuring a 400-seat forum for study and social interaction.
cards.evidence_claim: The 400-seat forum of the atrium provides a space for study and social interaction at the heart of the Wall Academic Center.
cards.source_title: E. Craig Wall Jr. Academic Center Davidson College - Shepley Bulfinch
cards.access_notes: Accessible during academic building hours; typically open late for student use.

cards.title: The Quiet Sloan Nook
cards.subtitle: Sloan Music Center
cards.notes: Head to the main level of Sloan for a quieter, more secluded alternative to the main library, featuring multimedia stations and large study tables.
cards.short_summary: A specialized library in the Sloan Music Center offering a quiet environment for focused study.
cards.evidence_claim: The Music Library in Sloan Music Center includes individual and group multimedia stations and networked computers for student use.
cards.access_notes: Open during Sloan Music Center hours; check LibCal for specific library desk hours.

cards.title: The Non-Denominational Oasis
cards.subtitle: Alvarez College Union
cards.notes: Find peace in this quiet, non-denominational space on the top floor of the Union, designed for reflection and spiritual reprieve.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated quiet space in the Alvarez College Union for students of all religious and spiritual traditions.
cards.evidence_claim: The Oasis is a non-denominational space open to students of all religious traditions, located in the Alvarez College Union.
cards.source_title: Alvarez College Union Experiences Changes - Davidson College
cards.access_notes: Located on the fourth floor of the Alvarez College Union; open during building hours.

cards.title: The Lavender Lounge
cards.subtitle: Belk Residence Hall
cards.notes: Gather in this welcoming LGBTQIA+ community space on the lower level of Belk Hall, featuring a library of over 300 films and books.
cards.short_summary: A community lounge for LGBTQIA+ students and allies located in the lower level of Belk Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Lavender Lounge is located on the lower level of Belk Residence Hall and serves as a welcoming environment for LGBTQIA+ students.
cards.access_notes: Open to all members of the Davidson community throughout the academic year.

cards.title: Chambers Student Lounge
cards.subtitle: Chambers Building
cards.notes: Utilize this dedicated student lounge within the Chambers Building for quick study sessions between classes in the college's primary academic hall.
cards.short_summary: A student-focused lounge located within the historic Chambers Building.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hines Family Student Lounge is listed as a facility within the Chambers Building.
cards.access_notes: Accessible during Chambers Building academic hours.

cards.title: Diversity & Inclusion Lounge
cards.subtitle: Alvarez College Union
cards.notes: Relax in this community-building space in the Union, designed for organic conversation, games, and refreshments among diverse student groups.
cards.short_summary: A student-centered lounge within the Center for Student Diversity and Inclusion in the Alvarez Union.
cards.evidence_claim: The CSDI in the Alvarez College Union has a student-centered lounge that strives to be a community building space.
cards.source_title: Center for Student Diversity and Inclusion - Davidson College
cards.access_notes: Located within the CSDI suite in the Alvarez College Union; open during building hours.

cards.title: The Dome Auditorium
cards.subtitle: Chambers Building
cards.notes: Look up at the historic brick dome in this top-floor auditorium, recently upgraded for high-end acoustics and used for student club meetings and screenings.
cards.short_summary: A 115-seat presentation space located under the dome of the Chambers Building.
cards.evidence_claim: Hance Auditorium is a 115-seat multi-purpose presentation space located on the top floor, under the dome of the Chambers Building.
cards.source_title: Davidson College Hance Auditorium - Thorburn Associates
cards.access_notes: Used for classes and scheduled student organization meetings; accessible via the top floor of Chambers.

cards.title: The Silent Study Retreat
cards.subtitle: Tomlinson Hall
cards.notes: Find the absolute quiet of the former library basement in this 24-hour conference room, now designated as a primary silent study zone.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour silent study space located in the basement of Tomlinson Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The silent study once relegated to the basement of the old library can now be found in the Tomlinson conference room.
cards.source_title: How to Use the College Library During Renovations - Davidson College
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours for students; CatCard access required outside of business hours.

cards.title: The Union Living Room
cards.subtitle: Alvarez College Union
cards.notes: Relax in this comfortable lounge located just inside the terrace entrance of the Knobloch Campus Center, perfect for casual meetings.
cards.short_summary: A central lounge and gathering space located within the Alvarez College Union.
cards.evidence_claim: Johnston Living Room is located just inside the terrace entrance to the Knobloch Campus Center.
cards.access_notes: Open during Alvarez College Union building hours.
